content: Geeshshatethan duus
Kirstoosi ba ashon waaye ekkida gish inteka ola olettiza miishe gixxida asa mala hayssa ha qofan minnidi giigettite. Ba ashon waaye beyida asi nagara ooso aggides.
Hessafe guye ba diza wode ubban izi daanay iita asho amotethi ooson gidonta dishe Xoossa shene polona.

Hinko dere asati ooththizayssa mala inte coo mela yeda duussan asho amon, mathon, ogey baynda kaassan, wogappe aaththi uyidi durusaninne harassiza eeqa goynnon kase inte aaththida wodezi intes gidana.
Ha7i qas inte ha yo7ozan istara wogay baynda qiixi qiixonta gish isti malaletetessinne intena cayeettes.
Gido attin hayqqidayta bollanne paxa dizayta bolla pirdanas giigi uttidayssas isti zaaro immana.
Hayqqidaytassara Mishiraachcho qaalay yootetiday hessa gishassa. Hessathoka ay asa bollaka pirdiza mala ista asho bolla pirdana. Ista shempoy qas Xoossi diza mala de7on deyana.
Xoossa imotata wogara go7eteth
Hessa gish wode wursethi matides. Inte minni woossanas dandayana mala wogara diitenne woppu gida qofay intes de7o.
Siiqoy daro nagara kammiza gish harappe bollara inte inte garsan lo7ethi siiqetite.
Zuuzunthi baynda issoy issa imathateth mokki ekkite.
Dumma dumma gidida Xoossa kiyatetha imotata ammanetethan oykkidi intefe issi issi asi baas imettida Xoossa kiyatetha imotan hara as maaddo.

Tamarsizadey Xoossa qaala tamarsiza mala tamarso; hagazizadey Xoossi izas immiza wolqan hagazo; hessa malan Xoossi Yesus Kirstoosa baggara haniza ubban galattettana. Bonchoynne godateth mernappe merna gakkanaas izas gido. Amiin!
Meto dandayo
Ta siiqoto! Inte tama mala paaciza meto giddon geliza wode hessa malay kase baynda ooratha miishi gakkidaz intes misatin malaletofte.
Hessafe bollara Kirstoosa bonchoy qonciza wode inte keehi ufayettana mala inte izara iza waayeza ekkizayta gidida mala ufayetite.
Inte Kirstoosa suntha gish cayettikko boncho Ayanay hessika Xoossa Ayanay inte bolla shempiza gish ufayeetite.
Intefe oona bollaka metoy gakkikko hessadey shempo wodhida asa mala, kayso mala, iita ooththida asa malanne asa yo7o giddo coo woxxi gelidade mala gidoppo.
Izi ammanizade gidida gish iza bolla gakkiza metoy diikko qas Kirstoosa sunthan izi Xoossa galato attin yeellatoppo.
Pirday doomettanas wodey matides. He pirday doomettanay koyro Xoossa asa bollakko! Histin pirday nunan doommikko Xoossa Mishiraachcho qaalas azazettonta ixida asa wursethi ay gidanee?
Geeshsha Maxaafay “Xilloykka waaydi attanaz gidikko, hanko Xoossas goynnonta asaynne nagaranchati waanandetoo?” giza mala.
Hessa gish Xoossa shene mala waayetiza asati banateththa wursi ammanettida bana medhdhidayssas hadara immidi lo7o ooso ooththonta aggofeto.
